Hello, fellow Methuselah !
The European Championship will take place in Paris, France on Saturday the
22nd and on Sunday the 23rd of September.

That's tempting but I have some questions:

1. What about language issues - especially French vs English?

Messages.Author: Carl Pilhatsch
Messages.Body:
ra...@videotron.ca (Remy Auclair) wrote in message news:<3b390574...@news.videotron.ca>...


For an EC, the official language *has* to be English, of course. Table
talk has to be in English, if at least one player doesn't speak the
local language. The last two ECs made a shining example of this, there
have been no problems regarding language at all, judges being also of
great help there... :)

Carl
